What is INI CET?

INI CET or Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test is conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Delhi for admission to PG courses such as Masters of Surgery (MS) , Doctor of Medicine (MD) , Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) , Doctorate of Medicine (DM) , and Master of Chirurgiae (MCh). INI CET scores are valid for admission to 19 AIIMS, JIPMER Puducherry, PGI Chandigarh, NIMHANS, Bengaluru, and SCTIMST, Trivandrum. All these institutes admit PG students on the basis of the marks obtained in the INI CET exam only. Earlier these institutes used to conduct separate exams for admission to PG courses. The exam is conducted twice a year, January and July session.
